//: Purpose: Carry the baseline security headers for responses Vercel serves from the filesystem, which src/hooks.server.ts never sees. Why: the adapter's generated route table puts {"handle":"filesystem"} ahead of the SSR rewrites, so /_app assets, /service-worker.js and everything under static/ are returned before the SvelteKit function runs; measured against a production preview, those responses carried no security headers at all. Info flow: request -> Vercel edge matches source -> headers attached -> static file returned. Sources deliberately list only filesystem-served paths so these can never duplicate the headers hooks.server.ts already sets on documents - a repeated X-Frame-Options is ignored outright by some browsers. Strict-Transport-Security is omitted because Vercel's edge already sets it on every response, and Content-Security-Policy is omitted because it is document-scoped and nonce-managed by SvelteKit.
